description: "The Shadow of a Sin" by Charlotte M. Brame is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story centers around Hyacinth Vaughan, a young woman suffocated by the oppressive atmosphere of her wealthy but stifling home life, controlled by her strict and dull guardians, Lady Vaughan and Sir Arthur.
